# Mantrap

> Physical security training for data center staff and guards: access control, mantraps, tailgating, visitor management and security compliance.

Mantrap (https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Access Control & Physical Security, Physical Security & Access (1 hr), Security & Compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001) training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Access Control & Physical Security](https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/courses/access-control-physical-security): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Practical security training for facility staff — access control, surveillance, and incident reporting. Enroll: https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/courses/access-control-physical-security?buy=828
- [Data Center Physical Security and Access Control Training](https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-physical-security-access-control): $99.99 per seat, 1 Hour. Foundational physical security and access control practices for data hall environments. Enroll: https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-physical-security-access-control?buy=855
- [Security & Compliance for Data Centers](https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/courses/security-compliance-data-centers): $291.99 per seat, 16 Hours, SOC 2 / ISO 27001. Build a facility security program that satisfies SOC 2, ISO 27001, and physical audit requirements. Enroll: https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/courses/security-compliance-data-centers?buy=848

## Guides

- [Stopping tailgating](https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/guides/stopping-tailgating): The most common physical security failure, and the polite way to prevent it.
- [The layers of data center physical security](https://dc-access-control.hazwoperosha.us/guides/layers-of-data-center-security): From the fence line to the rack, each layer narrows who gets through.
